clue.text: Possibly a lunch break when office assistant's kept in

indicators.note: something kept in another is held inside it, so the assistant goes within the break

explanation.surface: A lunch hour taken while the office assistant is made to stay behind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Possibly' marks lunch as one example of the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A meal of any kind can be called this, and lunch is one example of such a meal.

clue.text: Go on drug-fuelled demonstration

indicators.note: a thing fuelled has its fuel put inside it, so the drug goes within the demonstration

parts.note: a rally is a political demonstration

explanation.surface: An instruction to join a protest march fuelled by drugs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Go on' is the exclamation of disbelief, not a command.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are exclamations of surprise or disbelief: 'Go on!' and its equivalent asking whether something is true.

clue.text: School of philosophy to put in scheme —- is wanting head of metaphysics

indicators.note: to is put in the scheme, placed inside it
the head of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A philosophy school whose scheme lacks a leading metaphysician.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wanting' looks like 'lacking' but here means 'needing', adding M.
explanation.definitionFit: The doctrines of Plato and his followers form a school of philosophical thought.

clue.text: Essay's only content is mere assertion

indicators.note: the content of words is what is inside them, so the letters are within

explanation.surface: A critic dismisses an essay's sole substance as unsupported claim.
explanation.walkthrough: 'content' looks like the essay's subject, but signals letters inside the words.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: someone's word or bare statement, authority with no proof, is a mere assertion.

clue.text: Winds and weathers variable

indicators.note: variable means changeable, so the letters of the following word are in an altered order

explanation.surface: A weather report: winds and conditions keep changing.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to wind something around, as garlands or smoke curling, is to encircle in coils.

clue.text: Approve of skill that's important to the bourgeois?

parts.note: to respect is to esteem, approve of

explanation.surface: Valuing a talent prized by the middle classes.
explanation.definitionFit: Social standing and decency is stereotypically the chief concern of the middle class.

clue.text: Article exceptionally quaint, line offered by seller of the old-fashioned?

indicators.note: exceptionally means in an unusual way, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An unusually quaint item offered by an antiques dealer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exceptionally' turns QUAINT into NTIQUA.
explanation.definitionFit: A collector of or dealer in antiques and relics trades in old-fashioned things.

clue.text: Dye forms layer — surfaces of natural attractiveness submerged

indicators.note: submerged means lying below, so in this down entry those letters come after

parts.note: a hen is a bird that lays eggs

indicators.note: the surface of a word is its top, here its first letter

explanation.surface: A dye forms a coating, its natural appeal hidden beneath the surface.
explanation.walkthrough: 'layer' looks like a coat but is something that lays eggs.
explanation.definitionFit: A reddish-brown plant dye used on hair and skin.

clue.text: Officer material superior to worker?

indicators.note: superior means placed higher, above it in this down entry

explanation.surface: A uniform cloth marks the officer's rank over the labourers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'superior to' places SERGE above ANT.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a non-commissioned rank in the army and police is a kind of officer.

clue.text: Latest concept for movement, one adopted for geological study

indicators.note: movement of letters means they are shifted into a new order

explanation.surface: A newest idea about motion, adopted by one person for a geology project.
explanation.walkthrough: 'adopted' adds I to LATEST CONCEPT before the rearranging.
explanation.definitionFit: Geology: the study of moving plates in the earth's crust and their effects.

clue.text: A lady by window shelf knocked — over a plant

parts.note: Mary, a woman's name standing for any lady

indicators.note: a shelf knocked over is upended, so its word is read backwards here

parts.note: a sill is the shelf at the foot of a window

explanation.surface: A woman by the window knocks something off the sill, spilling a pot plant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'knocked over' turns SILL into LLIS.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the belladonna lily and related bulbous flowering plants carry this genus name.

clue.text: Fashion set by top woman's cosmetic preparation

parts.note: ton is an old word for the fashionable style or set

explanation.surface: A trend started by a leading lady's beauty product.
explanation.walkthrough: ER is the Queen, Elizabeth Regina, the country's top woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a skin lotion used to tighten pores is a cosmetic product applied after cleansing.

clue.text: Room appeared to be half finished

indicators.note: only half of the word is completed, so its first three of six letters are kept

explanation.surface: A half-decorated room in the middle of a refit.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal British word for a lavatory, a small room in a house.

clue.text: Soldiers get bashing here? That's perfectly fair

definitions.meaning: square-bashing is military drill done on the parade ground

explanation.surface: A soldier's grumble about drill, answered that it is only fair.
explanation.walkthrough: Square-bashing is British slang for drill on a barrack square.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: literally located on the parade ground, and idiomatically honest and above board.

clue.text: Game that's not hard when one officer intervenes

indicators.note: something that intervenes comes between, so these letters sit inside the shortened word
not hard means the letter for hard is taken away from the preceding word

parts.note: H, the pencil abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: A game made easier when an official steps in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Game that's' reads as one phrase, but 'that' is wordplay: 'not hard' strips its H, leaving TAT, and 'intervenes' sets the numeral and constable inside.
explanation.definitionFit: An old children's pastime in which a small tapered stick is struck to make it jump, then hit away.

clue.text: I can't be regarded as one agreeing

definitions.text: I can't be regarded as one
definitions.meaning: the letter I is a vowel, so it is not this kind of letter

explanation.surface: Someone protests that they cannot be seen as a yes-man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'I' is the letter, not the speaker.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a non-vowel letter, and harmonious or in accord.

clue.text: Money a head collected for informal conference

indicators.note: money collected round something holds it inside, so one word goes within the other

explanation.surface: Organisers charge a fee per person for an informal gathering.
explanation.definitionFit: A protest-style meeting for open discussion of an issue is an informal conference.

clue.text: Co-tenant shows abhorrence about mouse skittering around

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the shuffled letters sit within the word for abhorrence
a mouse skittering around darts about, its letters scattered into a new order

explanation.walkthrough: 'about' and 'around' look like a pair, but only 'about' is the container; 'skittering around' shuffles the rodent's letters to OUSEM.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: someone sharing a rented house with others is a fellow tenant.

clue.text: One violent type or another grabbing a policeman

indicators.note: grabbing means holding, so the other letters go inside

parts.note: another violent type, a rager, someone who rages

explanation.surface: One thug or another seizing a constable.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who goes on a violent spree is a kind of violent person.

clue.text: Gangster Bill seizes chap, a source of information

explanation.surface: A mobster with an invoice grabs someone, perhaps an informant.
explanation.definitionFit: An annual reference book of calendars, tides and facts is a source of information.

clue.text: Type of acquisition one's seen in bar

indicators.note: seen in means placed inside, so the pronoun sits within the word for bar

parts.note: one, the impersonal pronoun, can be replaced by you

explanation.surface: A takeover deal discussed by someone spotted in a pub.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bar' looks like a pub but means 'except'.
explanation.definitionFit: Purchase of a controlling share in a company is a kind of corporate acquisition.

clue.text: Mature, bathed in success? Don't change position!

explanation.surface: A veteran basking in triumph is told to freeze.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: a command to stay still, as a photographer might say, means don't move.

clue.text: Dosh earned from a crude product?

parts.words: Dosh earned from a crude product?

explanation.surface: Cash made from selling something vulgar or rough.

clue.text: Hearing in ship some Japanese verse

indicators.note: hearing signals the word as heard, not as written

explanation.surface: Listening aboard a vessel to Japanese poetry.

clue.text: President once expelling a daughter seeking power

clue.text: Conceit brings energy to the game

parts.note: E, the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: An arrogant player gives the match some vigour.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an inflated sense of self, vanity, is self-esteem in its excessive form.

clue.text: Cake and port

definitions.meaning: a rich fruit cake with almonds named after the Italian city

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a fruit cake topped with almonds, and the major Italian harbour city.

clue.text: Season topped and tailed with magnificent sort of function

indicators.note: topped and tailed means the first and last letters are cut off the word for the season

explanation.surface: A season described as trimmed and splendid, like a festive menu.

explanation.definitionFit: Mathematics: the expression to be integrated in calculus is a kind of function.

clue.text: Try out various treats, do!

indicators.note: various means differing, so the letters are put in a different order

explanation.surface: An invitation to sample assorted sweets at a party.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to test a car or idea in real conditions is to try it out.

clue.text: Numerically swamp pub, say, big meal not available at first

indicators.note: the first N and the A met reading along are removed, in that order

parts.note: an inn is an example of a pub
a feast is a big meal
N/A, the usual abbreviation for not available

explanation.surface: A crowd overruns a pub where the big dinner has not yet been served.
